'''Z2-B3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zasha Ranken]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Z2-B3 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the Imperial Flashpoint courier for the Kuat Drive Yards Flashpoint, though the droid is only found aboard Vaiken Spacedock and not on other planets like other couriers.<ref name="TOR" />
